comparison.objective: Tighten and fit a pre-threaded necktie on a rigid collar form.
comparison.physical_skill: Coordinated pulling, knot positioning and deformable-strip arrangement.
comparison.success_condition: Knot remains threaded and within fit tolerances, blades correctly arranged, hands released for 5 s, no damage or added support. No material rubric detail missing.
comparison.reason: Tests deformable dressing adjustment rather than rigid many-body screening.
